sources.note: Official May 2026 Rail and Busway Map. Pomona North is a solid open transfer (ML icon); dashed grey METRO A LINE EXTENSION PROJECT is east of Pomona North — out. Wilshire/La Cienega is a solid open D terminus; dashed grey METRO D LINE SUBWAY EXTENSION PROJECT is west of it — out. *Van Nuys Station closed until winter 2028 is a G Line overlay — out. Map prints 7th St/Metro Ctr, Civic Ctr/Grand Park, Little Tokyo/Arts Dist, East LA Civic Ctr, Heritage Sq, Lakewood Bl, LATTC/Ortho Institute. C Line station between Willowbrook/Rosa Parks and Lakewood Bl prints Lynwood (not Long Beach Bl).

City id los-angeles is a SEPARATE city. Do not invent city=la, city=lax, city=metro, city=lacmta, or city=us. Do not merge into washington / chicago / bart / boston. Agency LA Metro. Modes v1: Metro Rail ONLY (A B C D E K). No G Line, no J Line, no Metro bus, no Metrolink, no Amtrak, no LAX FlyAway, no airport people movers.

City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Not tester-live. Not live. Cut #1 is Rotterdam only. This pack stays planned. assertCityLive("los-angeles") must fail. Not in LIVE_CITY_IDS. Do not edit lib/, registry, or any product file.
Timezone America/Los_Angeles HAS DST (PDT/PST). Do not copy Perth / Brisbane no-DST.
Six printed Metro Rail lines on the current map (circles A B C D E K). No seventh rail line. G and J print as Metro Busway squares — out of v1.

Locked inner-city printed name: 7th St/Metro Ctr (A × B × D × E). Clash-report long form 7th Street/Metro Center. C and K do not serve this station. Not Union Station, not Civic Ctr/Grand Park, not Pershing Square, not Historic Broadway, not Pico, not Downtown, not LA.

Line ticks match Metro Facts at a Glance: A 48, B 14, C 12, D 11, E 29, K 13 (127 line ticks). 110 unique passenger-open Metro Rail stops after dedupe across shared trunks. How to Ride / Facts print 115 as the system figure (updated 11 May 2026 after D Line Section 1) — that is Metro's published total, not five extra names on this plate.

Open on this map (solid): D Line Section 1 Wilshire/La Brea, Wilshire/Fairfax, Wilshire/La Cienega; A Line Foothill Glendora, San Dimas, La Verne/Fairplex, Pomona North. Out (dashed UNDER CONSTRUCTION): further D Line west of Wilshire/La Cienega; further A Line east of Pomona North. C Line west end is LAX/Metro Transit Center (opened 2024/2025; airplane + LAX box). C Line station Lynwood (renamed from Long Beach Blvd on the June 2026 timetable and on this plate).
A Line Long Beach is a clockwise one-way loop: Anaheim St, 5th St, 1st St, Downtown Long Beach, Pacific Av. Pacific Av is a real map tick, not J Line Pacific Av in San Pedro.
